authorship.scope: Original foundation-level boundary-grid, heat stability/energy, leapfrog wave, and PDE convergence lectures with mathematical companions. Preserve the prior 61 manuscripts and their individual metadata.

description: Addresses topics from the lecture, including "Three unknown temperatures, not five"; "insulating the ends"; and "What happens when a boundary flux is prescribed?".
